notes.title: De-Mosaic & Steam Trading Cards!
notes.notes:
[p]The patch notes might not seem very intensive at first glance, but the changes they bring to the game are far reaching and comprehensive- the main one being the implementation of de-mosaic'd, uncensored, sex scenes! As you can imagine this was very time and labour intensive- but it's been one of the biggest things folks have been asking for, so we've been working on it![/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog:[/b][/p][p]_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _[/p][p][b]Most of the scenes have been uncensored-[/b] no more mosaic blur! More uncensored scenes are to come.
No need to install a patch or anything either, this just comes as part of the update.[/p][p][/p][p]Now beating the game (Epilogue included) will give you a 50% discount on CG records. You can have the over 90 innocence Archievement that reduces prices and this on top of it.[/p][p][/p][p]Some scenes received significant changes, Scenes 21 was reworked[/p][p][/p][p]Steam Trading Cards have been added- now playing the game will allow you to unlock special collectibles on your Steam account- collect the full set to turn them into badges which will also unlock backgrounds and emotes for your Steam profile![/p][p]_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _[/p][p]Additionally the game is discounted for the next two weeks, as well as most of the titles on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/tinyhat-studios"]TinyHat Studios publishing label![/url] Go check them out![/p]

notes.title: v3.2.3: Controller Support + Steam Cloud
notes.notes: [p]You asked, we listened! These two have probably been the most requested things we've heard about from launch, so we've been hard at work making sure they are implemented![/p][p][/p][p]The new controller support should also make the game fully Steam Deck friendly- I ordered a Deck but I am still waiting for it to arrive, so please let us know if you guys run into any weirdness when it comes to Steam Deck![/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, we've also been working on the various bugs and issues you guys have been bringing to our attention, resolving as many as we can![/p][p][/p][p]We're very happy to see the outpouring of love and support you guys are showing the game and we want to do our best to return it! So without further ado, here are the patch notes![/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog v3.2.3:[/b][/p][p]_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _[/p][p]Inventory item icons mismatch and effects not displaying correctly[/p][p]→ Fixed[/p][p][/p][p]Equipped weapons disappearing from inventory after being equipped[/p][p]→ Intended (It is deep within how the engine works with items.)[/p][p][/p][p]Cannot change movement key / cannot reset controls / can't unbind default arrow keys[/p][p]→ Acknowledged and resolved[/p][p][/p][p]Button presses too sensitive, skip multiple lines in text[/p][p]→ Explained as possibly due to \[Control] vs \[OK] key usage; will improve input mapping[/p][p][/p][p]Keybindings broken / cannot reassign movement keys[/p][p]→ Resolved[/p][p][/p][p]Weird bug in love hotel scene locking the player in logo view[/p][p]→ Fixed[/p][p][/p][p]Level up message displaying only when Working[/p][p]→ Acknowledged but delayed for future patch[/p][p][/p][p]Item related to a summoning quest gives alternate outcome[/p][p]→ Intended but might change in the future, (this ''item'' gives an alternate outcome to one sidequest)[/p][p][/p][p]Innocence reduction without lewd acts (killing hobos)[/p][p]→ Confirmed as intended behavior[/p][p][/p][p]New Game Plus causing quest bugs / "legendary ♥♥♥♥ game" remains[/p][p]→ Now \[Legendary ♥♥♥♥ game] removed in new game plus, Will be on the lookout for other items that might cause problems in NG+[/p][p][/p][p]Day 10 Boss was nerfed a bit (10% in various stats).[/p][p](I Will consider adding other outcomes to this day in particular later on.)[/p][p][/p][p][b]HOTFIX:[/b][/p][p]Transition bug on Nanami's Week start.[/p][p]→ Fixed[/p][p]Bug where some CGs would grey out and not allowed to be purchased[/p][p]→ Fixed[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog v3.2.5a:[/b][/p][p]_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _[/p][p]Changes to Achievement Saintly sinner and Collector.[/p][p]→ Fixed: Saintly Sinner had a problem with how it's parallel event was setup, While it was possible to get it, many people would fail to get it even with the right conditions, I made changes to this achievement so there's always a check when you get the Nanami Week prompt.[/p][p][/p][p]Changes to Achievement Collector.[/p][p]→ Adjusted: Collector was activated by interacting with a PC in the CG viewer after collecting every single one. Now It will have a Check on When exiting a CG shop.[/p][p][/p][p]Eria Added: New NPC, Filling the Space that was empty besides the police Station. [/p][p]→ She will be receiving more content in the future, but low priority Right now.[/p][p][/p][p]Police Station Door [/p][p]→ Now has a nice double door, inviting you to go in and meet the police chief [/p][p][/p][p]Buffer/Longer Loading to the East Section.[/p][p]→ Now East Section has a longer Loading (Just like the West section) to avoid Drops in performance when Loading into this place.[/p][p][/p][p]_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _[/p][p]I will be working hard as always, Next up in the priority is getting the de-mosaic done. I will be announcing more things in the future![/p]

notes.title: Echoes of the Town is Now Available!
notes.notes:
The game is fully complete- this is a 1.0 launch, [b]not[/b] an Early Access launch. However, we still have plans to provide some free updates! Nothing huge is currently planned, but we will be spending some more time working on things such as a much requested "de-mosaic" option for the adult scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227043/d23f37818c1ade856ab4cd64834fa0ef3a7caf71.png[/img]
It's been a long time coming- this is a very emotional moment for us, but we'll save the long-winded and heartfelt speeches for another time. There is a lot I want to say, but that can come alongside a future update. Right now the focus is on making sure launch goes smoothly!

What's more, we've cooked up a special deal for you guys- we're currently in a bundle with Tennis Angels EX! If you already own that game- you can get a discount on our game! If you don't own Tennis Angels, then you can get a discount on it AND Echoes of the Town if you buy them together!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54674/TinyHat__Toras_Wonderful_Waifus/
But without further ado, we hope you enjoy everything the game has to offer! If you have any questions or run into any problems, feel free to let us know either on the TinyHat Discord or here on the Steam forums!
